products.title: Black Full-Zip Hoodie OG Logo
products.body_html:
This full-zip hoodie is built to be worn and lived in. The midweight Re-Fleece fabric blends recycled cotton and polyester for a soft, broken-in feel that still holds structure thanks to side seams. A clean metal YKK zipper and understated chest emblem keep the look minimal and versatile — reach for it on early mornings, layered under a jacket for the commute, or while tinkering in the garage. The tear-away label removes irritation so you can forget it’s there and focus on what you’re doing. It’s comfort with purpose: eco-minded materials, durable construction, and a quiet style that moves with your day.

Product features
- 60% recycled cotton / 40% recycled polyester midweight Re-Fleece (approx. 8.1 oz)
- Durable metal YKK full zipper with dyed-to-match tape
- Side seams for improved shape retention and structure
- Tear-away label for zero-scratch comfort
- Available in Heather shades with recycled-rayon blends for soft, lived-in texture

Care instructions
- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F)
- Non-chlorine: bleach as needed
- Tumble dry: low heat
- Iron, steam or dry: medium heat
- Do not dryclean
